# Toast Notification

Provide a feedback when an action is completed.
See [Toast Notification guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/toast-notification/design/)

<Source code="import { Toast } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Toast/index.ts)

## Examples

### Float

Floating notifications are best placed at the bottom left of the screen.<br />
The component will switch to 100% width on screens smaller than `XS` <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="basic">breakpoint</LinkTo>

<Canvas of={ToastStories.Variants} />

### Small

<Canvas of={ToastStories.Small} />

### Inline

Inline notifications are best placed at the bottom center of the screen.<br />
The component will switch to 100% width on screens smaller than `SM` <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="basic">breakpoint</LinkTo>

<Canvas of={ToastStories.InlineMode} />

For inline toasts with a link we recommend referring to the below example to ensure proper alignment and spacing.

<Canvas of={ToastStories.InlineWithLink} />

```css
.toast-body {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}
.toast-link {
  margin-left: 0.5rem !important;
  min-width: 35% !important;
  max-width: 40% !important;
  justify-content: flex-end !important;
  text-align: right !important;
}
```
